raw_html: [[Nightmares]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Nightmares]]:''' This weapon terrorizes your foes, applying a Mind Thrust effect on successful hits (dealing 5 to 40 force damage, Will vs. [[Enchantment]]s negates) and exposing your foes to their greatest fears on [[Vorpal Strike|vorpal hits]], acting as a [[Phantasmal Killer]] spell.
